_meta.coverage_scope_note: Version 1.0.0 provides published guidance values and circle rates across primary Indian metropolitan economic centers with geospatial coordinates (center_lat, center_lon, radius_km) for resilient spatial matching without reverse geocoding dependency. Tier-2/3 municipalities are scheduled for version 1.1.0.
_meta.mandatory_disclaimer: Indicative guidance-value estimate based on published state government circle rates. Local sub-registrar rates vary by specific survey number, road width, and municipal tax ward. Verify official valuation and stamp duty with the local Sub-Registrar Office before legal transaction.
